mapping_requirements.owner_defined_extensibility: a future field, relationship or record class requires a successor version of this owner that declares its type, unit or precision, presence arms, cardinality, target role, mapping disposition, fixture coverage and source-neutral semantics. mapping_requirements.configuration_mapping_evidence: Every nonidentity enum or boolean translation pins exact documentary byte ranges, names a complete source domain or explicit unsupported values, proves target type and refuses unknown values. mapping_requirements.detail_request_binding: An operation response without the resource key may bind to the exact documented request member under the same selected provider/service/resource/operation and source scope.
